prior_expectations.subject: Jonah Coleman
prior_expectations.statement: If his availability and backfield competition do not materially change, Coleman should remain involved in both rushing and receiving rather than depend only on a touchdown.
prior_expectations.support: Week8 11 carries and5 targets versusDobbins7 carries; new price5300.
prior_expectations.uncertainty: Single game; Harvey availability and all backfield roles not verified forWeek9.
prior_expectations.challenge: A reduced role or disappearance of receiving opportunity despite active status would challenge the premise.
prior_expectations.observe: Postgame carries, targets, receptions and teammate distribution; routes/snaps unassessable without a reliable source.

prior_expectations.subject: Adonai Mitchell
prior_expectations.statement: Mitchell is selected for continued meaningful receiving involvement alongside Wilson, not for a repeat of142yards or an assumed team-leading share.
prior_expectations.support: FreshWeek8 box:9targets versusWilson12; prior zero-catch week is contrary evidence.
prior_expectations.uncertainty: One strong game, current receiver availability andWeek9QB/protection conditions uncertain.
prior_expectations.challenge: Few receiving opportunities while active and teammates continue drawing targets would challenge the role selection.
prior_expectations.observe: Targets, receptions, team attempts and receiver distribution; distinguish a low-volume team game from loss of individual share.

prior_expectations.subject: Harold Fannin Jr.
prior_expectations.statement: Fannin should retain a meaningful receiving role if active, rather than be chosen merely because last week's154yards must recur.
prior_expectations.support: Week8 12 targets versusConcepcion4 andBoston11; olderWeek6three-target failure remains relevant contrary evidence.
prior_expectations.uncertainty: ClevelandQB continuity, protection and blocking deployment not established; a prior bounce does not prove persistence.
prior_expectations.challenge: Targets shift away while he is active, or evidence he primarily blocks, would challenge the role premise.
prior_expectations.observe: Targets/receptions versus team attempts and other receivers; assess QB changes and any sourced routes/blocking separately from points.

prior_expectations.subject: San Francisco DST / Nick Bosa
prior_expectations.statement: Bosa is expected to return to participation for the selected defense after Friday full practice and explicit coach clearance; a normal full snap load is not assumed.
prior_expectations.support: Primary Friday report says FP and no game designation, with coach clearance. This removes one prior availability concern.
prior_expectations.uncertainty: He has been sidelined since Week2; Sunday inactivity, a limited rotation and in-game setback remain possible. Other secondary players questionable.
prior_expectations.challenge: Inactive status or restricted participation would challenge the return condition; active status alone does not establish pass-rush effectiveness.
prior_expectations.observe: Official active list and participation/snaps if available; sacks/turnovers and opponent passing volume separately. Pressure data unassessable if not accessible.

prior_expectations.subject: Adonai Mitchell
prior_expectations.statement: Mitchell is retained for meaningful receiving involvement with Wilson ruled out, without assuming he inherits Wilson's entire workload or repeats142yards.

prior_expectations.uncertainty: Passing volume, coverage and distribution among Mitchell/Cooper/Taylor/backs remain unknown.
prior_expectations.challenge: Few opportunities while active despite team passing involvement elsewhere would challenge the retained role case.
prior_expectations.observe: Targets, catches, team attempts and target distribution; distinguish low teamvolume from loss of individual involvement.
